output.review_comment: The PR violates the original docstring's explicit contract ("values are never averaged or interpolated") by adding interpolation logic. More critically, it contains test-specific code: the special case `if p == 50 and n % 2 == 0:` is engineered precisely to pass test_median_response_time. This indicates a fundamental contradiction between the docstring specification (no interpolation) and the test expectations. Rather than silently changing the docstring to match a single test, this should be flagged to clarify the actual requirements. Either implement the documented nearest-rank method or request explicit approval to change the specification.
